en.headline: Ocean Park announces conservation facilities ahead of 50th anniversary
en.dek: The park will open a marine mammal conservation centre next January displaying a Bryde's whale skeleton and a new panda pavilion in the third quarter of next year as it marks 50 years in 2027.
body: Ocean Park Hong Kong said it will mark its 50th anniversary on 10 January 2027 with a series of conservation and education facilities under the theme of continuing a moving future for animals, people and nature.

A marine mammal conservation centre, converted from the former Arctic Adventure attraction, is scheduled to open next January and will display the full skeleton of an eight-metre Bryde's whale that stranded in Sai Kung in 2023, together with research exhibits and interactive elements on climate and pollution.

A new pavilion for the park's six giant pandas is expected to open in the third quarter of next year, with reconfigured habitats and a high observation platform for monitoring and public viewing of care routines.

The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau said the government continues to support the park's animal care and conservation work and plans to develop it as a conservation education base. The park is also collecting public photographs and stories from past visits for possible use in anniversary materials.

zh.headline: 海洋公園公布50周年保育設施 明年展出布氏鯨骨骼
zh.dek: 園區明年1月10日迎來50周年，將開設海洋哺乳動物保育中心展出西貢擱淺布氏鯨骨骼標本，並於明年第三季啟用全新大熊貓展館。
body: 海洋公園表示，將於2027年1月10日迎來50周年，推出以延續動人未來為題的一系列保育及教育設施，寓意動物、人與自然。
由北極之旅改建的海洋哺乳動物保育中心預計明年1月開幕，首度展出2023年西貢擱淺的8米長布氏鯨全副骨骼標本，並結合科研成果及沉浸式裝置，讓公眾了解氣候變化及污染。
全新大熊貓展館預計明年第三季啟用，將重新規劃現有設施，提供適合六隻大熊貓的棲息環境，並設高空觀察台方便監察及公眾近距離觀看日常護理。
文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩表示，政府繼續支持園區在動物護理及保育方面的工作，並計劃將其打造成保育研學教育基地。園方亦正收集公眾舊照片及文字，或用於周年宣傳。
